title: Sublinear Variational Optimization of Gaussian Mixture Models with Millions to Billions of Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2501.12299v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) range among the most frequently used models in machine learning. However, training large, general GMMs becomes computationally prohibitive for data sets that have many data points $N$ of high-dimensionality $D$. For GMMs with arbitrary covariances, we here derive a highly efficient variational approximation, which is then integrated with mixtures of factor analyzers (MFAs). For GMMs with $C$ components, our proposed algorithm substantially reduces runtime complexity from $\mathcal{O}(NCD^2)$ per iteration to a complexity scaling linearly with $D$ and sublinearly with $NC$. In numerical experiments, we first validate that the complexity reduction results in a sublinear scaling for the entire GMM optimization process. translated_title: 具有数百万至数十亿参数的高斯混合模型的次线性变分优化
translated_abstract: 高斯混合模型（GMM）是机器学习中最常用的模型之一。然而，对于拥有大量数据点N且维度D很高的数据集，训练大型通用GMM在计算上变得令人望而却步。针对具有任意协方差的GMM，本文推导出一种高效的变分近似方法，并将其与因子分析混合模型（MFA）相结合。对于具有C个分量的GMM，所提出的算法显著降低了每次迭代的运行时间复杂度，从𝒪(NCD²)降至关于D呈线性、关于NC呈次线性的复杂度。在数值实验中，作者首先验证了复杂度的降低使整个GMM优化过程实现了次线性扩展；其次，在大规模基准测试中表明该次线性算法相比最先进方法实现了数量级的加速；第三，作为概念验证，作者（展示了该方法在实际应用中的有效性）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对具有任意协方差的高斯混合模型的高效变分优化算法，将每次迭代的运行时间复杂度从𝒪(NCD²)降至关于维度线性、关于数据量与分量数次线性，使得训练拥有数百万至数十亿参数的大规模GMM成为可能，并实现了相比最先进方法一个数量级的加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a highly efficient variational optimization algorithm for Gaussian Mixture Models with arbitrary covariances, reducing per-iteration runtime complexity from O(NCD²) to linear in D and sublinear in NC, enabling the training of GMMs with millions to billions of parameters and achieving order-of-magnitude speedups over state-of-the-art methods.
